segments.text:
V. 2.
And was transfigured—Or transformed. The indwelling Deity darted out its Rays through the Veil of his Fleſh: And that with ſuch tranſcendent Splendor, that He no longer b•re the Form of a Servant. His Face ſhone with divine Majeſty, like the Sun in its Strength; and all his Body was ſo irradiated by it, that his Cloaths could not conceal its Glory, but became white and glittering as the very Light, with which He covered Himſelf as with a Garment.
